create_UNet_conv_layers: create UNet downconv and upconv layers with configurable input/output channels and normalization
build_conv_block: build a two-layer convolution block with batch normalization and LeakyReLU activation
build_up_conv_layer: build an upsampling convolution layer with optional outermost sigmoid output
initialize_resnet18_features: initialize a Resnet18 feature extractor with custom input channels and optional fully-connected layer
run_visualvoice_unet: run the VisualVoiceUNet to generate audio separation masks from mixed audio and visual features
